run_evaluation_on_slurm: run LCM evaluation tasks on SLURM by scheduling EvalRunModule instances with a Hydra launcher
schedule_tasks_with_launcher: schedule and run sharded evaluation tasks asynchronously on SLURM using a configured launcher
setup_slurm_launcher: set up a SLURM launcher from Hydra config overrides and job arguments
parse_evaluation_configs: parse CLI configs into run configurations for creating EvalRunModule task instances
create_eval_run_modules: create EvalRunModule instances from parsed run configs with requirements and shard settings
